brief: Prioritise Westmarch Park for pre-event attention before the forecast heat event, as units of advanced age with high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Where the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Re-prioritise any outstanding work against its effect on the unit's ability to shed heat, completing categories 1 to 3 before the event begins wherever crew capacity allows ([SOP-016]).
